description: Set Knockout Group and Isolate Blending (Transparency panel) on groups, other items or layers. Knockout stops the objects inside from showing through each other; Isolate Blending keeps blending modes inside the group or layer

knockout.description: on, off, or inherit (the neutral state of the checkbox)

layers.description: Layer names, instead of or as well as target

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_transparency_group
title: Set Transparency Group
